$comment: Registry of known contextkit sub-modules. `contextkit add <name>` resolves names here; any git URL also works. Each module is its own git repository following the module contract (docs/modules.md). Registration only reveals a module's name, source URL, and description — being listed here doesn't make a private repo clonable; `add` still needs real git access to `source`.

personal.$comment: Private repo, only clonable with Victor's own git credentials. Registered so `contextkit add personal` resolves by name from any of his machines; not usable by anyone else.
